groups.sentence: Students check that AI output is not plagiarized or a direct copy of existing work, verify original sources, and cite them.
Students must not use AI to generate bibliographies, references or citations, and must do their own research.
AI output can plagiarize or misrepresent sources and give unclear attribution, false citations, or summaries.
Students should not submit or lightly edit AI text that closely mirrors existing sources.
Students must not leave AI-generated citations uncorrected or fail to notice that AI edited quotes and paraphrases.
AI tools use existing sources without citation, risking plagiarism or copied content.
